key_types.purpose: Adds node for every resource in config tree; handles import target matching

key_types.name: TargetingTransformer
key_types.purpose: Prunes graph to targeted nodes + ancestors; or removes excluded nodes + descendants

key_types.name: ReferenceTransformer
key_types.purpose: Adds dependency edges from HCL static analysis via ReferenceMap

key_types.name: TransitiveReductionTransformer
key_types.purpose: Final cleanup: calls AcyclicGraph.TransitiveReduction()

key_types.name: ResolvedProvider
key_types.purpose: Fully resolved provider binding with Instance factory fn, IsMocked, MockResources

key_types.name: ProviderFunctionMapping
key_types.purpose: module+function-addr → resolved provider instance; populated by ProviderFunctionTransformer

patterns: transformer pipeline: BasicGraphBuilder.Build() iterates ordered Steps []GraphTransformer
abstract-to-concrete node promotion via factory functions at graph-build time
dynamic subgraph expansion: nodes implementing GraphNodeDynamicExpandable produce child graphs at walk time
module-scoped EvalContext: Graph.walk() calls EnterPath/ExitPath for each GraphNodeModuleInstance
proxy provider pattern: graphNodeProxyProvider resolved and removed by ProviderTransformer + PruneProviderTransformer
reference-based dependency graph via HCL static analysis (lang.ReferencesInBlock)
targeting/excluding: Ancestors() for targets; Descendents() for excludes

nodes.name: Meta
nodes.purpose: Shared state embedded in all command structs. Carries all injected dependencies from package main.
key_methods: CommandContext() context.Context
InterruptibleContext(base) (context.Context, CancelFunc) — cancels on ShutdownCh
RunOperation(ctx, be, opReq) (*RunningOperation, Diagnostics) — handles SIGINT double-tap with 5s timeout
contextOpts(ctx) (*tofu.ContextOpts, error) — builds engine ContextOpts
Workspace(ctx) (string, error) — reads TF_WORKSPACE or .terraform/environment

nodes.name: ApplyCommand
nodes.purpose: Implements 'tofu apply' and 'tofu destroy' (Destroy:true field). Runs: ParseApply → PrepareBackend → OperationRequest → RunOperation → render outputs.

nodes.name: PlanCommand
nodes.purpose: Implements 'tofu plan'. Returns exit code 2 when -detailed-exitcode and changes present.

nodes.name: InitCommand
nodes.purpose: Implements 'tofu init'. Downloads modules, initializes backend, installs providers, updates lock file.
patterns: InstallerEvents callbacks stream progress to view during provider installation

nodes.name: ValidateCommand
nodes.purpose: Implements 'tofu validate'. Loads config, creates tofu.Context, calls Validate(), routes through unified Results view.

nodes.name: FmtCommand
nodes.purpose: Implements 'tofu fmt'. Reformats .tf/.tofu/.tfvars/.tftest.hcl files using hclwrite. Exit code 3 in check mode with unformatted files.
patterns: delegates diff generation to system 'diff' binary
formats token-level via formatValueExpr/formatTypeExpr
unwraps single-expr interpolations

nodes.name: View
nodes.purpose: Root shared view type. Manages terminal streams, colorization, warning/error consolidation, diagnostics formatting.
key_methods: NewView(streams) *View
Configure(view *arguments.View) — applies parsed global flags
Diagnostics(diags) — deduplication, consolidation, compact-warnings, color-aware formatting
patterns: interface-based view layer: every command has Human + JSON + Multi implementations
-json-into handled by Multi fan-out wrapper (human→stdout + JSON→file simultaneously)
OperationHuman.Plan() uses JSON plan intermediate (jsonplan.MarshalForRenderer) even for human output
ValidateJSON emits single JSON object to stdout (format_version='1.0') NOT hclog streaming
JSON_UI_VERSION = '1.2' must be bumped on schema changes

nodes.name: arguments
nodes.purpose: Argument parsing layer. ParseXxx functions return typed arg structs. Global flags pre-parsed by ParseView() and stripped before per-command parsing.

key_types.name: ViewOptions
key_types.purpose: -json/-json-into flags; mutually exclusive; -json forces InputEnabled=false

key_types.name: View
key_types.purpose: Global flags: NoColor, CompactWarnings, ConsolidateWarnings, ConsolidateErrors, Concise, ShowSensitive, ModuleDeprecationWarnLvl

edges.via: resource instance and module instance addresses

observed_patterns: Dual-form pattern: every change/state type exists in decoded (cty.Value) and serialized (DynamicValue/JSON bytes 'Src') forms with Encode/Decode converters
SyncWrapper pattern: mutable shared data structures (State, Changes) have a SyncState/ChangesSync wrapper that adds mutex protection and deep-copy on read
Transformer pipeline: graph construction via ordered []GraphTransformer steps; each step is independently testable
Interface sealing via unexported sigil methods (addrs package Referenceable, Targetable, etc.)
Three-context graceful shutdown: ctx (values only) → stopCtx (graceful stop) → cancelCtx (immediate abort)
Factory function pattern: command factories, provider factories, node factories — all lazy construction
Hook system: observer/interceptor pattern for infrastructure lifecycle events; HookActionHalt for cooperative cancellation
Abstract-to-concrete node promotion: graph builders accept factory functions to convert abstract nodes to operation-specific concrete nodes
Static evaluation at config load time: resolves module sources, backend, provider for_each before runtime
Envelope encryption: data key metadata stored alongside ciphertext in JSON envelope; fallback chain for migration
Parallel operations protected by per-operation flock files (provider installation) or semaphore (graph walk)
Address provenance tracking: every variable value carries a ValueSourceType rune indicating its origin

naming.interfaces: Named by capability without I prefix (Backend, Provider, Encryption, Method)
naming.graph_nodes: node* prefix (lowercase, unexported) for concrete; Node* prefix (exported) for abstract/public

testing.test_helpers: BuildState() / BuildChanges() convenience constructors, OverrideForTesting() for experiments
testing.provider_mocking: testingOverrides struct in command.Meta for injecting mock providers without plugin discovery

error_handling.grpc_errors: grpcErr() helper maps gRPC status to tfdiags.Diagnostics
error_handling.provider_errors: Typed errors in getproviders (ErrHostNoProviders, ErrProviderNotFound, etc.) and encryption (ErrKeyProviderFailure, ErrCryptoFailure, etc.)
